title: 第12章一巴掌拍碎父子情
novel_title: 莫欺老年穷，一天增加一个天赋点
content_zh:
“我没有钱给你。”

    陈安的声音平淡。

    “以前没有，现在没有，以后……也不会再有。”

    此话一出，陈龙先是一愣，紧接着陈龙心中的怒火便是被点燃了。

    他面容扭曲，唾沫横飞地咆哮起来：“老不死的，你翅膀硬了是吧？在镖局看了几天门，就敢不给老子钱了？我看你是活腻了！”

    话音未落，他那只蒲扇般粗壮的手掌，便恶狠狠地朝着陈安的衣领抓来，带起一阵恶风。

    就在那只手即将触碰到衣领的刹那。

    陈安动了。

    他的动作快得超乎想象，一声爆喝，如平地惊雷般在这荒坡上炸响！

    “逆子！”

    “啪！！！”

    一道清脆到极致的耳光声，响彻了整个山坡，甚至盖过了风声。

    陈安的一巴掌，携着《鲸吞功》凝练的恐怖力道，结结实实地抽在了陈龙的脸上。

    陈龙整个人如同被高速奔行的骏马迎面撞中，陀螺般原地转了两圈，口中喷出一大口混杂着七八颗碎牙的血沫，身体横飞出数米之远，重重摔在地上，发出一声闷响。

    他彻底懵了。

    挣扎着想要爬起，却只感觉半边脸已经彻底失去了知觉，紧随而至的，是火烧一般的剧痛。

    那张脸以肉眼可见的速度高高肿起，迅速变得紫青一片，触目惊心。

    “呜……你……你敢打我……”

    他口齿漏风，含糊不清地嘶吼着，眼中满是难以置信。

    陈安缓步走到他面前，居高临下地看着他，那眼神比数九寒冬的风还要冷。

    “从今日起，我陈安，没有你这个儿子。”

    “你我父子恩情，就此断绝。”

    “你好自为之。”

    说完，他再也没有看地上如同烂泥般的陈龙一眼，转身回到墓碑前。

    他用一双无比平稳的手，将散落的祭品一一收拾妥当，仿佛刚才什么都没有发生过。

    随即，迈开脚步，佝偻的背影没有丝毫留恋，头也不回地朝着山下走去。

    身后，陈龙捂着自己被彻底毁掉的半张脸，从最初的震惊与剧痛中回过神来。

    他看着陈安那决绝的背影，一双眼睛里燃烧起怨毒到极致的火焰，那股恨意，几乎要化为实质。

    “老不死的……你等着……我一定……一定要你死！”

    ……

    回到风云镖局，陈安将自己关在房中。
content_en:
"I don't have any money to give you."

    Chen An's voice was calm.

    "It didn't happen before, it doesn't happen now, and it won't happen again..."

    As soon as these words came out, Chen Long was stunned for a moment, and then the anger in Chen Long's heart was ignited.

    His face was distorted, and he roared with saliva flying: "Old immortal, your wings are stiff, aren't you? You have been in the escort agency for a few days, and you dare not give me money? I think you are tired of living!"

    Before he finished speaking, his thick palm like a cattail fan fiercely grabbed at Chen An's collar, causing a gust of evil wind.

    The moment that hand was about to touch the collar.

    Chen An moved.

    His movements were faster than expected, and a loud roar exploded on the desolate slope like thunder on the ground!

    "Treason!"

    "Crack!!!"

    A slap that was so crisp that it resounded throughout the entire hillside, even covering up the sound of the wind.

    Chen An's slap, with the terrifying power condensed in the "Whale Swallowing Kung Fu", hit Chen Long's face firmly.

    Chen Long felt as if he was hit head-on by a high-speed running horse. He spun around twice like a top. A large mouthful of blood mixed with seven or eight broken teeth came out of his mouth. His body flew several meters away and fell heavily to the ground with a muffled sound.

    He was completely confused.

    He struggled to get up, but only felt that half of his face had completely lost consciousness, followed closely by a burning pain.

    The face swelled up at a speed visible to the naked eye, and quickly turned purple and blue, which was shocking.

    "Oh... you... you dare to hit me..."

    He was lisping and roaring incoherently, his eyes full of disbelief.

    Chen An walked up to him slowly and looked at him condescendingly, his eyes colder than the cold winter wind.

    "From today on, I, Chen An, don't have a son like you."

    "The friendship between you and me as father and son is now severed."

    "You take care of yourself."

    After saying that, he never looked at Chen Long who was on the ground like mud again, and turned back to the tombstone.

    With a pair of extremely steady hands, he packed up the scattered sacrifices one by one, as if nothing had happened just now.

    Immediately, he took steps forward, his rickety back showed no trace of nostalgia, and walked down the mountain without looking back.

    Behind him, Chen Long covered half of his completely destroyed face, recovering from the initial shock and severe pain.

    He looked at Chen An's resolute back, and his eyes burned with flames of extreme hatred, and that hatred almost turned into reality.

    "Immortal... just wait... I will... definitely want you to die!"

    …

    Back at Fengyun Escort Bureau, Chen An locked himself in the room.
title_en: Chapter 12: Breaking the relationship between father and son with one slap
